summary: At home, Bjorn notices that he no longer knows every route and errand in the household and chooses not to demand an inventory.
settingText: Safe Cave, early evening as people return from separate routines.

panelPlan.action: Gunnar reads at the table. First Male Kin repairs a bag. Second Male Kin enters carrying a small purchase; Bjorn’s eyes widen briefly and track him across the room. Astrid is not present.
After the door closes, Bjorn glances from Gunnar to First Male Kin, then Second Male Kin, then back to the empty doorway.
Gunnar catches Bjorn looking toward the empty doorway and looks up from his book.
Bjorn turns his head toward the empty doorway while saying he does not know where everyone is. Gunnar answers without looking up from the book.
Bjorn looks once more across the room, then lowers himself onto a chair near the wall. The doorway remains quiet.

dialogueInline.text: I do not know where everyone is.

directionInline: Astrid is off-page. Only First Male Kin and Second Male Kin appear among the Kin.

summary: At closing time, the Bodega Owner finally asks Bjorn for difficult physical help and gives him one precise role in moving a refrigerator case.
settingText: Recurring bodega near closing: narrow front aisle, counter corner and newly delivered refrigerated display cabinet.

panelPlan.action: A narrow refrigerated display cabinet will not clear a counter corner. Two delivery workers and the Bodega Owner study the angle; floor mat and counter leave only inches of space.
Bjorn enters for his usual purchase. The owner sees him and points immediately at the cabinet.
The owner crouches beside one lower corner, points to the exact handhold and measures a two-inch lift with thumb and forefinger. Bjorn nods and repeats the limit back.
On the owner’s cue, Bjorn lifts his corner about two inches. The two delivery workers pivot the cabinet while the owner guides the near edge with both hands.
Afterward the owner hands Bjorn his regular coffee. Bjorn accepts it without reaching for another crate or task.

dialogueInline.text: Actually. You. I need the ridiculous shoulders.
Lift here. Two inches. Only when I say.

summary: Before another meeting, the 1987 Participant tells Bjorn that the dinner went badly, they left on their own terms, and their brother later invited them back under better ones.
settingText: Sidewalk outside the community center and the entry corridor before a later meeting.

panelPlan.action: Bjorn approaches alone. 1987 Participant waits by the door holding a takeout container, keys and phone visible in the other hand, coat open over ordinary contemporary clothes.
The participant lifts the takeout container slightly while saying “I went.” Bjorn stops in front of them and waits for the rest.
The participant opens both hands at “They did it again,” then hooks a thumb toward the street while saying “I left.”
They enter side by side. The participant taps the phone in one hand while mentioning the next-day call; Bjorn turns his head toward them for “Better terms.”

dialogueInline.text: They did it again. Questions. Jokes. My brother told them to stop. They didn't. I left.
He called me the next day. Asked me back. Just him this time.

summary: At a later meeting, Bjorn stops analyzing everyone else and says his own fear aloud: if nobody needs his protection, he does not know his place.
settingText: Community-center multipurpose room during a later support-group meeting.

panelPlan.action: A normal silence settles over the group. Bjorn sits with both hands flat on his knees and his eyes fixed on the floor.
Bjorn lifts his head, draws one breath and raises two fingers slightly from his knee before speaking.
Several participants glance up but remain in their chairs. The facilitator keeps the same seated posture while answering “Okay.”
Bjorn holds the facilitator’s gaze, jaw relaxed, with both hands flat on his knees as he speaks.
The facilitator remains still through the answer. Bjorn’s brow furrows after the first sentence and he tilts his head before replying.

dialogueInline.text: If my people do not need my protection, I do not know what my place is among them.
You don't have to be needed before you can be useful.

summary: Back home, Bjorn leaves several ordinary tasks alone until one male Kin asks for his hand on a repair and Gunnar asks for his judgment on a book illustration.
settingText: Safe Cave, evening, with ordinary repair, groceries and library books in progress at the same time.

panelPlan.action: Gunnar compares two library books. First Male Kin wrestles with a stubborn clamp on a small repair. Second Male Kin sorts groceries. Bjorn enters; his eyes move from the books to the clamp to the groceries, then he stops near the door with both hands empty.

panelPlan.location: Safe Cave doorway to main room
panelPlan.action: Bjorn removes his coat and sits. The others continue what they were doing without turning toward him.
First Male Kin looks over, holds the clamp out by one end and points to the loose joint. Bjorn rises and braces that joint with one hand.

panelPlan.shotType: medium on Gunnar and open book
panelPlan.action: Gunnar holds the open book toward Bjorn while asking about the lunar-tide illustration. After Bjorn answers, Gunnar taps the illustration with one finger before asking for his judgment on it.
Bjorn keeps one hand bracing the repair while leaning toward Gunnar’s open book; his other hand stays off both the tools and the book.

dialogueInline.text: This one says the sea level changes because the moon pulls it.
I want your judgment on the picture.

directionInline: Show exactly the two established male Kin. Astrid is not visible on this page.

summary: Late that night, the household continues several separate routines around Bjorn, and he answers Carrie's question about the group by saying, 'There is work here.'
settingText: Safe Cave, late evening: window, table and whole-room geography with everyone returning to ordinary separate routines.

panelPlan.action: Gunnar reads. First Male Kin continues a small repair while Second Male Kin sorts groceries. Astrid enters in the background carrying one small bag; First Male Kin gives her a brief nod and Second Male Kin shifts aside to let her pass. Carrie sits at the table with coffee, no folder visible. Bjorn stands near the window.
Carrie looks toward Bjorn and asks about the group without getting up from the table.
Bjorn turns one shoulder and his head slightly toward Carrie, expression grave.
Carrie lifts one eyebrow, delivers her reply and takes another sip of coffee.
Bjorn looks across the room: repair, books, groceries, Astrid putting away her bag, Carrie resting. Everyone continues their activity without looking toward him for direction.

panelPlan.location: Safe Cave window with room behind Bjorn
panelPlan.action: Bjorn faces Carrie in the foreground. Behind him Gunnar keeps reading, the two male Kin continue their separate tasks, and Astrid puts away the small bag as he answers.

directionInline: Astrid’s return remains background business: one small bag, no explanation dialogue, and no special reaction from the household.
